name: table
description: A source-owned shadcn-style Table for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational (Table/TableHeader/TableBody/TableFooter/TableRow/TableHead/TableCell/TableCaption), matching upstream's own non-interactive implementation. Table wraps the real <table> in a relative/overflow-x-auto scroll container, matching upstream's horizontal-scroll behavior for wide tables.
documentation.accessibility: Plain native `<table>` markup with semantic `<thead>`/`<tbody>`/`<tfoot>`/`<th>`/`<td>` (`registry/ui/table.rs`); `TableRow`'s classes include a `[role=checkbox]` hook for a selection-column pattern, but selection state itself is caller-composed.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; native table semantics only (no roving-focus cell navigation).
